{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /root/.claude/skills/brand-guidelines\n\n# Anthropic Brand Styling\r\n\r\n## Overview\r\n\r\nTo access Anthropic's official brand identity and style resources, use this skill.\r\n\r\n**Keywords**: branding, corporate identity, visual identity, post-processing, styling, brand colors, typography, Anthropic brand, visual formatting, visual design\r\n\r\n## Brand Guidelines\r\n\r\n### Colors\r\n\r\n**Main Colors:**\r\n\r\n- Dark: `#141413` - Primary text and dark backgrounds\r\n- Light: `#faf9f5` - Light backgrounds and text on dark\r\n- Mid Gray: `#b0aea5` - Secondary elements\r\n- Light Gray: `#e8e6dc` - Subtle backgrounds\r\n\r\n**Accent Colors:**\r\n\r\n- Orange: `#d97757` - Primary accent\r\n- Blue: `#6a9bcc` - Secondary accent\r\n- Green: `#788c5d` - Tertiary accent\r\n\r\n### Typography\r\n\r\n- **Headings**: Poppins (with Arial fallback)\r\n- **Body Text**: Lora (with Georgia fallback)\r\n- **Note**: Fonts should be pre-installed in your environment for best results\r\n\r\n## Features\r\n\r\n### Smart Font Application\r\n\r\n- Applies Poppins font to headings (24pt and larger)\r\n- Applies Lora font to body text\r\n- Automatically falls back to Arial/Georgia if custom fonts unavailable\r\n- Preserves readability across all systems\r\n\r\n### Text Styling\r\n\r\n- Headings (24pt+): Poppins font\r\n- Body text: Lora font\r\n- Smart color selection based on background\r\n- Preserves text hierarchy and formatting\r\n\r\n### Shape and Accent Colors\r\n\r\n- Non-text shapes use accent colors\r\n- Cycles through orange, blue, and green accents\r\n- Maintains visual interest while staying on-brand\r\n\r\n## Technical Details\r\n\r\n### Font Management\r\n\r\n- Uses system-installed Poppins and Lora fonts when available\r\n- Provides automatic fallback to Arial (headings) and Georgia (body)\r\n- No font installation required - works with existing system fonts\r\n- For best results, pre-install Poppins and Lora fonts in your environment\r\n\r\n### Color Application\r\n\r\n- Uses RGB color values for precise brand matching\r\n- Applied via python-pptx's RGBColor class\r\n- Maintains color fidelity across different systems"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"7f547437-7176-417f-8767-c798f3422faa","uuid":"e532dd58-cd48-46d3-b45e-34c0f2194af6","timestamp":"2026-03-22T15:51:14.083Z","isSynthetic":true}

fnt(DEJAVU_SERIF,  28)\nF_MICRO   = fnt(DEJAVU_SERIF,  22)\nF_MONO    = fnt(DEJAVU_MONO,   24)\n\n# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\ndef text_c(txt, y, = y0\n    while y < y1:\n        d.line([(x, y), (x, min(y + seg, y1))], fill=col, width=lw)\n        y += seg + gap\n\n# Annotation helpers — text anchored to fixed left/right margins\nTEXT_R = 510   # right edge of left-side text block\nTEXT_L = 1870  # left edge of right-side text block\n\ndef ann_left(x_comp, y_mid, label, sub=None):\n    # Leader line: component edge → TEXT_R\n    d.line([(TEXT_R, y_mid), (x_comp, y_mid)], fill=C_GRAY, width=1)\n    d.ellipse([x_comp - 4, y_mid - 4, x_comp + 4, y_mid + 4], fill=C_GRAY)\n    d.ellipse([TEXT_R - 3, y_mid - 3, TEXT_R + 3, y_mid +  = 476;  TOP_H  = 168\nPCB_Y  = TOP_Y + TOP_H + GAP   # 734\nPCB_H  = 270\nTHM_Y  = PCB_Y + PCB_H + GAP   # 1094\nTHM_H  = 160\nBOT_Y  = THM_Y + THM_H + GAP   # 1344\nBOT_H  = 130\n\n# ── EXPLOSION dashed_v(gx, PCB_Y + PCB_H, THM_Y, GUIDE_COL)\n    dashed_v(gx, THM_Y + THM_H, BOT_Y, GUIDE_COL)\n\n# ── 1. PAD_L, LEG_Y)], fill=dk(C_GRAY, 0.25), width=1)\nLEG_Y += 18\n\nBOM = [\n    (C_LIGHT,  \"OUTER ENCLOSURE\",         \"CNC Aluminium Composite Shell  ·  Corporate Light   #faf9f5\"),\n    (C_GREEN,  \"PCB SUBSTRATE\",           \"Multi-layer FR4 Stackup  ·  Tertiary Brand Accent   #788c5d\"),\n    (C_BLUE,   \"THERMAL MANAGEMENT UNIT\", \"Fin Array Heatsink  ·  Secondary Brand Accent        #6a9bcc\"),\n    (C_ORANGE, \"CONNECTOR HIGHLIGHTS\",    \"I/O Panel & Primary Details  ·  Primary Brand Accent #d97757\"),\n    (C_GRAY,   \"ANNOTATION LINES\",        \"Leader & Dimension Lines  ·  Muted Mid Gray          #b0aea5\"),\n]\nROW_H = 52\nfor col, name, desc in BOM:\n    SW = 26\n    d.rectangle([PAD_L, LEG_Y+4, PAD_L+SW, LEG_Y+SW+4], fill=col)\n    d.rectangle([PAD_L, LEG_Y+4, PAD_L+SW, LEG_Y+SW+4], outline=dk(C_GRAY, 0.5), width=1)\n    d.text((PAD_L + SW + 16, LEG_Y), name, font=F_LABEL, fill=C_LIGHT)\n    bb = d.textbbox((0, 0), name, font=F_LABEL)\n    d.text((PAD_L + SW + 16 + bb[2]-bb[0] + 28, LEG_Y + 5), desc, font=F_MICRO, fill=C_GRAY)\n    LEG_Y += ROW_H\n\n# ── TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\nSPEC_Y = LEG_Y + 58\nd.text((PAD_L, SPEC_Y), \"TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS\", font=F_CAT, fill=dk(C_GRAY, 0.85))\nSPEC_Y += 48\nd.line([(PAD_L, SPEC_Y), (W - PAD_L, SPEC_Y)], fill=dk(C_GRAY, 0.25), width=1)\nSPEC_Y += 18\n\nSPECS = [\n    (\"SoC\",            \"Arm Cortex-A78AE  ·  6-core  ·  2.4 GHz  ·  Integrated NPU 26 TOPS\"),\n    (\"Memory\",         \"8 GB LPDDR5X  ·  Error Correcting Code (ECC)\"),\n    (\"Storage\",        \"64 GB eMMC 5.1  +  M.2 2242 NVMe expansion slot\"),\n    (\"Connectivity\",   \"2× 10 GbE (SFP+)  ·  Wi-Fi 6E  ·  Bluetooth 5.3\"),\n    (\"I/O\",            \"USB 3.2 Gen2  ·  UART  ·  SPI  ·  I²C  ·  GPIO ×40\"),\n    (\"Power\",          \"12 V DC  ·  3.5 A  ·  42 W TDP max  ·  18 W typical\"),\n    (\"Operating Temp\", \"−20 °C to +70 °C  ·  Fanless  ·  IP40 rated\"),\n    (\"Dimensions\",     \"120 × 80 × 42 mm\"),\n    (\"Weight\",         \"340 g  (without mounting bracket)\"),\n]\nCOL2_X = PAD_L + 400\nfor key, val in SPECS:\n    d.text((PAD_L,  SPEC_Y), key, font=F_SMALL, fill=C_GRAY)\n    d.text((COL2_X, SPEC_Y), val, font=F_SMALL, fill=C_LIGHT)\n    SPEC_Y += 44\n    d.line([(PAD_L, SPEC_Y-2), (W-PAD_L, SPEC_Y-2)], fill=dk(C_GRAY, 0.18), width=1)\n\n# ── FOOTER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nFT_Y = H - (bb[2]-bb[0])//2, FT_Y), mid_t, font=F_MICRO, fill=dk(C_GRAY, 0.75))\nrt = \"DOC-HW-ORION-001  ·  REV A  ·  2026\"\nbb = d.textbbox((0, 0), rt, font=F_MICRO)\nd.text((W - 200 - (bb[2]-bb[0]), FT_Y), rt, font=F_MICRO, fill=C_GRAY)\n\n# Bottom accent bar\nd.rectangle([0, H-8, W, H], fill=C_ORANGE)\n\n# ── SAVE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nout = \"/root/orion_technical_poster.png\"\nimg.save(out, \"PNG\", dpi=(300, 300))\nprint(f\"Saved: {out}  ({W}×{H}px)\")\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null}}
